notes.title: Stern Minor Update!
notes.content:
Today we're bringing you a minor update for minor quality of life improvements and bug fixes, many thanks for the patience and we hope that these changes make the experience smoother and more accessible for everyone.

[h2]Patch notes[/h2]

[h3][System Improvements][/h3]

Asset used for the tutorial replaced to avoid confusions
Spawn location re-positioned closer to the wreck when Tutorial is not selected
Updated name for Lifeboat davit
Updated excursion limit on stern area 
Improved collisions for more smoother viewing of the hull
Updated UI value controls



[h3][Bug Fixes][/h3]

Fixed: Performance issues on stern section due to collision geometry. 
Fixed: Sound beep when volume is at zero. 
Fixed: Overlapping in voiceover when completing the last scanning objective
Fixed: Game Runs now in Fullscreen mode from start
Fixed: video quality settings, audio settings and camera sensitivity settings are now saved between game sessions

Many thanks,

-The Team at Magellan

notes.title: vROVpilot: Expect an update soon!
notes.content:
Hello guys!

We just wanted to drop in with a quick update. We’ve seen your feedback around issues with the recent Stern update in vROVpilot. We’re on it. The development team is actively working on fixes and improvements as we speak.

Huge thanks for your patience and for sticking with us. We really appreciate the support and the challenges you've shared. A patch/update is on the way very soon, so hang tight!

More news shortly,

– The Team at Magellan

notes.title: vROV: Titanic | Stern Update
notes.content:
The Team at Magellan are very excited to bring everybody the long-awaited Stern addition to the vROVpilot portal. 

[h2]New Content[/h2]
New stern mission added
11 scannable stern items

[h2]System Improvements[/h2]
Texture optimization
Realism spotlight intensity adaptation 

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
Fixed scan validation shader not always well visible
Fixed mission timer restart after opening the menu 
Scanner triggering now more precise
Fixed camera rotation being limited with ROV switch 


[h3]Words from the team[/h3]
We want to take a moment to acknowledge the overwhelmingly positive feedback we've received from our incredible community. While we've heard your calls for other features and improvements, Magellan made the decision to prioritise the release of the stern section into vROVpilot to align with both the anniversary of the RMS Titanic's fateful maiden voyage and our Q1 Road Map commitments. We understand this may have shifted focus away from some of the enhancements you've been eagerly awaiting, and we genuinely appreciate your continued patience and support.

Please know that your suggestions and insights remain at the heart of our development process. The community’s voice is instrumental in shaping what comes next, and we’re already at work incorporating those changes into upcoming updates. We're committed to delivering the best possible experience and are excited to share more with you soon. 

Thank you for being part of this journey.
